meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 Chat SDK 桥接接入 GitHub:用专用机器人账号在 PR 和 issue 的评论线程里回复。有人在评论里 @ 到它之后,该线程被订阅,后续评论它也会回应。
howto.when: 当 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 到机器人账号时接管(用户名须与 GITHUB_BOT_USERNAME 完全一致);首次 @ 后,该线程的后续评论都会触发。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 频道接到这个 agent group 上
把 PR 和 issue 评论线程设成 per-thread 会话模式
say.note: 每个 PR/issue 得到独立会话

say.text: 把 @my-org-bot 加为可触发 agent 的成员
say.note: 公开仓库用 strict 策略时需要

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude connects to GitHub via the Chat SDK bridge: a dedicated bot account replies in PR and issue comment threads. After someone @-mentions it there, that thread is subscribed and later comments get answers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @-mentions the bot username in a PR or issue comment; after the first mention, all follow-up comments in that thread trigger it.

say_en.text: Wire the GitHub channel to my agent group
Set per-thread session mode for PR and issue threads
say_en.note: Each PR or issue gets its own session

say_en.text: Add @my-org-bot as a member that can trigger the agent
say_en.note: Needed for strict mode on public repos
